what: Clicking a same-site link brings three color curtains hidden below the screen (accent → dark surface → light surface, each higher one has a bottom 4px shorter so the lower curtain’s edge shows as a thin band) up from below at .1s stagger over .8s power3.inOut to cover and move on. On the arriving page, starting from the top light curtain in reverse (−.1s stagger) it goes down at the same length and lifts away

options.dur: Duration of one veil’s movement (sec), default .8 — 0 skips the veil and moves on immediately
options.mark: Key to leave as 1 in sessionStorage when covering (so the next page’s hero loader is skipped — same name as the skip of slit-wall-intro), none by default
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Curtains (children, several — the original has three). If absent, the part creates three
options.--fx-l1 · --fx-l2 · --fx-l3: Curtain color (css variable), default var(--kf-accent) · var(--kf-raised) · var(--kf-contrast-bg)
options.[data-no-wipe]: Links inside this go straight through without a transition

note: The original hangs GSAP timelines on next-transition-router leave · enter (.transition-layer y 0% ↔ 100%). The copy opens the document anew and runs the uncover on the arriving side

from.where: All pages .vl-veil, original TransitionProvider: leave y 0% · .8s · stagger .1 · power3.inOut, enter y 100% · stagger −.1 · curtain blue #4879ef · ink #29292b (bottom 4px) · light #f3f3f3 (bottom 8px)
